title: Ingo Swann remote views ruined cities on Mars

tellings.quote: Swan also re remote viewed Mars in the early8s and he said these same people who he had seen on the moon were responsible for a civilization uh the ruins of which he viewed on Mars.

plain: Ingo Swann was a remote viewer, someone said to describe faraway places using only the mind. A philosopher, Jason Jorjani, says that Swann viewed Mars this way in the early 1980s and reported that the same beings he had earlier seen on the Moon had built a civilization there, whose ruins he saw. If true, a non-human people would have lived on both the Moon and Mars.
